botcomponent.description: Upload ONE finished XLSX generated by write-loan-excel-skill. Pass text=the batch_folder from the ZIP manifest and file={name,contentBytes} from its upload JSON. Reuse the same batch folder for all applications in that ZIP. This workflow only stores the XLSX in OneDrive; it does not unzip, read PDFs, reason or populate Excel. Never pass the original ZIP or PDFs. Only Status/text=uploaded with a nonempty WorkbookPath/text_1 confirms storage.
botcomponent.name: SaveLoanWorkbookToOneDrive
